questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: Identify the stage holding raw sensory traces briefly
questions.stem: An engineer sizes a buffer that retains raw sensor readings for roughly half a second before decay; which memory stage does this describe?

options.text: A stage holding unprocessed sensory traces for under a second
A stage that encodes episodes into long-term store
options.misconception: confuses brief sensory hold with consolidation

options.text: A stage that stores interpreted meaning for minutes
options.misconception: confuses sensory storage with short-term retention

options.text: A stage that retrieves facts on demand
options.misconception: confuses storage buffer with retrieval process

questions.explanation: Sensory memory holds raw, unprocessed impressions for a fraction of a second. Short-term and long-term stages operate on interpreted information, not raw traces.
questions.hint: Think about duration and processing level.
